Patient-level survival data

Source: R/group_data_patient.R
group_data_patient.Rd

Convert a patient-level right-censored survival dataset from a randomized 2-arm trial into the standardized format used by retrogroup.

Usage

group_data_patient(data, arm, treatment, time, event)

Arguments

data

Data frame with one row per patient. Must have the columns named by arm, time, and event. Other columns are ignored.

arm

Character string, name of the column in data with the treatment arm. Must have no missing values and exactly two unique values.

treatment

The value of data[[arm]] that denotes the treatment arm. The other value denotes the control arm.

time

Character string, name of the column in data with the time since randomization of the event or censoring. The column must be numeric, finite, non-negative, and free of missing values.

event

Character string, name of the column in data with the event indicator: 1 or TRUE for an event, 0 or FALSE for right censoring. Must have no missing values and at least one event.

Value

A tibble with one row per patient and the following columns:

  • treatment: integer, 1 for the treatment arm and 0 for the control arm.

  • time: numeric, time since randomization of the event or censoring.

  • event: integer, 1 if the event occurred and 0 if censored.

See also

Other data: group_data_summary()

Examples

  data <- group_example_patient()
  group_data_patient(
    data,
    arm = "arm",
    treatment = "Lev+5FU",
    time = "time",
    event = "event"
  )
#> # A tibble: 619 × 3
#>    treatment  time event
#>        <int> <dbl> <int>
#>  1         1  1521     1
#>  2         1  3087     0
#>  3         0   963     1
#>  4         1   293     1
#>  5         0   659     1
#>  6         1  1767     1
#>  7         0  3192     0
#>  8         1  3308     0
#>  9         1  3309     0
#> 10         0  2085     1
#> # ℹ 609 more rows
